blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — At least 1,000 families lost their homes on Thursday afternoon due to massive fire that hit a residential area in Carpenter, Purok Corias, Barangay Leon Garcia of Agdao District here. Fire Inspector Frances Marie Sendrijas said the fire was reported around 5:06 p.m. The situation immediately reached second alarm at 5:13 p.m. No casualty was reported during the incident. Some 15 fire trucks from the Bureau of Fire Protection, coming from all of the city’s fire stations, were deployed. Sendrijas said this is the biggest fire in the area so far since January this year.
